name: Falchion
summary: A burst laser, paired torso Shortbows and secondary emitters reward flanking. Jump jets buy an angle; the narrow hull still punishes careless trades.
lore: The Falchion cradles at Vasi were marked INTERCEPT and faced the door. Long limbs and integrated lift channels survived beneath the preservation armour. Modern service work restores the alignment; shared mounts let workshop racks serve beside advanced emitters when replacements are scarce. A Falchion can cross a firing lane and answer a heavier machine, but its pilot still has to leave. Staying for another exchange spends cooling margin that precise maintenance cannot supply in the field.
strengths: Accurate burst laser and close missile volleys
Fast, narrow frame with jump jets
weaknesses: Hot battery needs pauses between volleys
Missile bins and light structure punish exposure
